efxpt:issue.message: Input frequency 5.00MHz (after pre-divider) is out of range. Min=16MHz Max=800MHz.
Multiplier is invalid. Valid values are 4,2,1.
Pre-divider is invalid. Valid values are 4,2,1.
These HSIO GPIO must be placed at least 1 pair away from LVDS tmds_tx_clk in order to avoid noise coupling from GPIO to LVDS: GPIOR_P_09
